description:
Links for one part of a GrooveSheet library song, to hand to the user.

Always returns the song page. For a part with sheet music it adds the sheet
music page, where the score can be read online. Every file download (PDF,
Guitar Pro, stem audio, MIDI, MusicXML) needs a free GrooveSheet account on
the song page; this tool never returns raw file URLs.

instrument.description: Part to get: drums, piano, bass, guitar, vocals or other.
